scope: elementary particles are the primary research objects; QED/QCD/electroweak/QFT/string-inspired frameworks are explanatory or design tools rather than substitute research objects

up_down_quark_finding.technology_interest: up/down flavor and associated quantum-number differences can be used as research primitives indirectly through hadron/isospin structure or encoded gauge-theory simulations
up_down_quark_finding.hard_blocker: QCD confinement prevents ordinary isolated free-quark device states

neutrino_finding.technology_interest: three-flavor dynamics has already been encoded on qubit/qutrit hardware, making it an experimentally grounded particle-dynamics bridge
neutrino_finding.hard_blocker: weak interaction makes direct state preparation, switching and readout impractical for ordinary devices

speculative_candidate_rule: axion/ALP, sterile-neutrino, dark-photon, neutralino and graviton candidates may generate sensor/simulator/model research but cannot be promoted to direct-particle technology while empirical status remains unconfirmed
screening_score_warning: ordinal research-priority heuristic only; not measured performance, energy, cost, fidelity or technological readiness level

FUND-PARTICLE-003: neutrino flavor -> qutrit information-encoding/resource audit
